name: build_personal_bulletin_module
query: ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades RENAME COLUMN user_id TO student_id; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades RENAME COLUMN subject TO subject_label_legacy; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades RENAME COLUMN coefficient TO subject_coefficient_legacy; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades RENAME COLUMN observation TO comment; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subject_offering_id uuid REFERENCES public.course_subject_offerings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_by_student boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades ALTER COLUMN subject_coefficient_legacy DROP NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades ALTER COLUMN comment DROP NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades ALTER COLUMN comment SET DEFAULT NULL; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS edutech_grades_grade_check; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades ADD CONSTRAINT edutech_grades_score_bounds CHECK (grade >= 0 AND max_grade > 0 AND grade <= max_grade); ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS edutech_grades_term_check; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades ADD CONSTRAINT edutech_grades_term_check CHECK (term IN ('T1','T2','T3')); ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS edutech_grades_assessment_type_check; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades ADD CONSTRAINT edutech_grades_assessment_type_check CHECK (assessment_type IN ('devoir_classe','interrogation','composition','examen','autre')); ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS edutech_grades_school_year_check; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_grades ADD CONSTRAINT edutech_grades_school_year_check CHECK (school_year ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}$'); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS edutech_grades_student_period_idx ON public.edutech_grades(student_id, school_year, term, assessment_date DESC); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS edutech_grades_student_offering_idx ON public.edutech_grades(student_id, subject_offering_id); ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS level_id uuid REFERENCES public.levels(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS series_id uuid REFERENCES public.series(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subject_id uuid REFERENCES public.subjects(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subject_offering_id uuid REFERENCES public.course_subject_offerings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_name text; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_document text; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_url text; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_reference text; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_version text; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_verified boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verified_at timestamptz; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficients ALTER COLUMN coefficient DROP NOT NULL; UPDATE public.edutech_coefficients SET is_verified=false, source_name=COALESCE(source_name,'Non vérifié'), source_document=COALESCE(source_document,'Aucun document officiel vérifiable rattaché') WHERE is_verified IS DISTINCT FROM true; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS edutech_coefficients_verified_offering_idx ON public.edutech_coefficients(subject_offering_id) WHERE is_verified AND subject_offering_id IS NOT NULL; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.edutech_coefficient_audit (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), coefficient_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.edutech_coefficients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, admin_id uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, action text NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('created','updated','deleted')), previous_value jsonb, current_value jsonb, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); ALTER TABLE public.edutech_coefficient_audit ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS edutech_coefficient_audit_admin_read ON public.edutech_coefficient_audit; CREATE POLICY edutech_coefficient_audit_admin_read ON public.edutech_coefficient_audit FOR SELECT USING (public.is_admin()); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edutech_set_updated_at() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $$; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS edutech_grades_set_updated_at ON public.edutech_grades; CREATE TRIGGER edutech_grades_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.edutech_grades FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.edutech_set_updated_at(); DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS edutech_coefficients_set_updated_at ON public.edutech_coefficients; CREATE TRIGGER edutech_coefficients_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.edutech_coefficients FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.edutech_set_updated_at(); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edutech_log_coefficient_change() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN INSERT INTO public.edutech_coefficient_audit(coefficient_id,admin_id,action,previous_value) VALUES (OLD.id,auth.uid(),'deleted',to_jsonb(OLD)); RETURN OLD; ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN INSERT INTO public.edutech_coefficient_audit(coefficient_id,admin_id,action,previous_value,current_value) VALUES (NEW.id,auth.uid(),'updated',to_jsonb(OLD),to_jsonb(NEW)); RETURN NEW; ELSE INSERT INTO public.edutech_coefficient_audit(coefficient_id,admin_id,action,current_value) VALUES (NEW.id,auth.uid(),'created',to_jsonb(NEW)); RETURN NEW; END IF; END; $$; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS edutech_coefficients_audit_changes ON public.edutech_coefficients; CREATE TRIGGER edutech_coefficients_audit_changes AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.edutech_coefficients FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.edutech_log_coefficient_change(); DROP POLICY IF EXISTS edutech_grades_self ON public.edutech_grades; CREATE POLICY edutech_grades_select_own ON public.edutech_grades FOR SELECT USING (student_id = auth.uid() OR public.is_admin()); CREATE POLICY edutech_grades_insert_own ON public.edutech_grades FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (student_id = auth.uid() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id = edutech_grades.subject_offering_id WHERE p.id = auth.uid() AND p.level_id = o.level_id AND p.series_id = o.series_id) OR public.is_admin()); CREATE POLICY edutech_grades_update_own ON public.edutech_grades FOR UPDATE USING (student_id = auth.uid() OR public.is_admin()) WITH CHECK ((student_id = auth.uid() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id = edutech_grades.subject_offering_id WHERE p.id = auth.uid() AND p.level_id = o.level_id AND p.series_id = o.series_id)) OR public.is_admin()); CREATE POLICY edutech_grades_delete_own ON public.edutech_grades FOR DELETE USING (student_id = auth.uid() OR public.is_admin()); DROP POLICY IF EXISTS schoolci_coefficients_admin ON public.edutech_coefficients; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS schoolci_coefficients_read ON public.edutech_coefficients; CREATE POLICY edutech_coefficients_read ON public.edutech_coefficients FOR SELECT USING (true); CREATE POLICY edutech_coefficients_admin_manage ON public.edutech_coefficients FOR ALL USING (public.is_admin()) WITH CHECK (public.is_admin()); REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.edutech_set_updated_at() FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.edutech_log_coefficient_change() FROM PUBLIC;
